c1.text: Hey Devin. I have a voice-controlled fantasy RPG called Hollowmere in my product-demo-apps repo, in the hollowmere folder. It's built with Expo, so one codebase runs on iOS, Android, and the web, and the companion, Eira, runs on GPT-Live-1 and carries out what the player says as tool calls.

c2.text: I want to add one feature. When the player says something like mark the barrow, Eira should call a new tool that drops a glowing waypoint marker in the world at that place, and pins it on the compass bar, until the player reaches it or says clear the marker.

c3.text: Oh, and make the marker a tall beam of light, so you can see it from across the valley.

c4.text: Test it on the web build in Chrome and on the iPhone simulator, with recordings of each, then open a pull request.

c6.text: Hey Devin, how's the waypoint feature coming along?

c7.text: Great. Let me know when the pull request is up.
